messages:
Alexa Rivera: @support getting 400 on /v1/rerank in prod for AcmeInc customer at 2026-03-16T09:12:14Z. API returns 400 with message "items must be array" and no candidate scores. Payload we received attached below.

Sam Liu: can you paste the exact curl you used to repro and the request id from logs?

Alexa Rivera: curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"request":{"items":"","topk":{"value":3},"candidates":""}}'

Jordan Park: I see the error in the proxy logs: parse error at parser.go:142: "items must be array". Server rejects when items != array or candidates != array. This looks like the mobile gateway is wrapping the original JSON in a 'request' envelope and converting empty arrays to empty strings.

Alexa Rivera: Repro locally with that curl -> 400. SDK in use is mobile-sdk v2.4.1 (Android). Customer says their gateway transforms payloads to strings for empty lists.

Ingrid Moss: devex note — older mobile SDK had a serde bug that sent [] -> "" when certain protobuf fields were unset. I'll reach out to mobile-sdk team. In the meantime, can we provide a short mitigation for customers?

Jordan Park: temporary mitigation: allow lenient parsing for rerank path that accepts empty-string as empty array behind a feature flag. I'll open a quick PR gated to dedicated deployments and add a metric. Marking P1? more like P2. ETA for hotfix: ~24 hours.

SupportBot: Incident INC-2026-1144 created and assigned to eng-oncall (Jordan Park).

Sam Liu: I'll reply to Acme with repro steps and ask them to work around by ensuring arrays are [] or to disable the gateway transform. Also asking them to upgrade to mobile-sdk v2.5.x where this is fixed.

Alexa Rivera: Customer reports their gateway is Kong + lua-transform plugin. They can add a rule to preserve empty arrays. Sharing config snippet:

```
-- lua transform example
local body = cjson.decode(ngx.req.get_body_data())
if body.request and type(body.request.items) == 'string' and body.request.items == '' then
  body.request.items = {}
end
ngx.req.set_body_data(cjson.encode(body))
```

Jordan Park: Thanks. I'll include a validation error message improvement to indicate when the root key is wrong (expecting items at top-level) vs envelope. Also adding a debug log that prints the incoming root keys to help support triage. :thumbsup:

Sam Liu: Action items: 1) tell Acme to patch gateway or send corrected payload 2) Jordan to open PR for lenient parsing + tests 3) Ingrid to contact mobile-sdk team 4) Postmortem if we see >5 customers affected. I'll update thread when hotfix lands.

Alexa Rivera: thanks all. Customer will try the Kong rule and report back. :rocket:
